map.📖 查看「配方成本核算使用指南」: 📖 See the "Recipe Cost Accounting User Guide"
map.成品理论产量 (g，用于计算单位成本): Theoretical finished yield (g, used to work out unit cost)
map.实际耗用量 = 配方用量 ÷ (1 − 损耗率)，单原料成本 = 单价 × 实际: Actual amount used = recipe quantity ÷ (1 − loss rate), and the cost of one ingredient = unit price × actual amount used (kg). The loss rate is the share lost in processing (peeling, shrinkage and so on). Unit cost = total cost ÷ finished yield.
map.损耗对单位成本影响: Effect of loss on unit cost
map.实际耗用 = 用量 ÷(1 − 损耗率/100)；单项成本 = 单价 × 实际耗: Actual amount used = quantity ÷(1 − loss rate/100); cost of one item = unit price × actual amount used ÷1000 (CNY); unit cost = total cost ÷ yield ×1000 (CNY/kg).
map.面粉 500 g@¥6/kg + 糖 200 g@¥8/kg + 黄油 300: Flour 500 g at ¥6/kg + sugar 200 g at ¥8/kg + butter 300 g at ¥40/kg (5% loss so 315.8 g actually used): total cost=3.0+1.6+12.63≈¥17.23, so at a 1000 g yield the unit cost is about ¥17.23/kg.
map.损耗率怎么填？: How do I enter the loss rate?
map.指加工中不可回收损耗（去皮、蒸发、粘附属），按实测填；0 表示按用量计。: It means the unrecoverable loss in processing (peeling, evaporation, sticking), so enter the measured value; 0 means costing by the recipe quantity alone.
map.单位成本为何高于总成本/产量？: Why is the unit cost higher than total cost divided by yield?
map.因损耗使实际耗用 > 配方量，单位成本被放大，更贴近真实成本。: Because loss makes the actual amount used greater than the recipe quantity, which inflates the unit cost and puts it closer to the real cost.
